Two separate fraud cases reported involving significant sums

Two separate incidents of financial fraud have been reported in India. In Bhopal, a businessman was allegedly duped of ₹16 lakh in a fake gold deal, leading to two individuals being booked by the police. Separately, in Bengaluru, an employee of a gold finance firm was defrauded of ₹26 lakh in connection with a PDO job scam.
